title: Existence of a localization with expected fibre dimensions
statement:
theorem localized_presentation_is_relativeGlobalCompleteIntersection
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)))
    (hdim : let S := MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)
      let p := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q
      c ≤ n ∧ topologicalKrullDimAt
        (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S p ⟨q, rfl⟩) = (n - c : ℕ))
    : ∃ h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R,
    let S := MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)
    let g : S := Ideal.Quotient.mk _ h
    g ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
    let relations : Option (Fin c) → MvPolynomial (Option (Fin n)) R :=
      Option.elim' (MvPolynomial.rename some h * MvPolynomial.X none - 1)
        (fun i ↦ MvPolynomial.rename some (f i))
    let T := MvPolynomial (Option (Fin n)) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range relations)
    IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection (algebraMap R T) ∧
      (∀ (p : Ideal R) (_hp : p.IsPrime),
        letI : p.IsPrime := _hp
        Nontrivial (p.Fiber T) →
          c + 1 ≤ n + 1 ∧
            topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum (p.Fiber T)) =
              (n + 1 - (c + 1) : ℕ))

proof.text: The quotient S is finite type by Mathlib instances. Apply Algebra.exists_away_fibre_dimension_le at q with d = n-c and hdim.2. It gives g outside q and an upper bound n-c on every nonzero fibre of S_g. Lift g to h using Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective. This packages the original open-neighbourhood and basic-open steps without changing their route.

Apply Algebra.exists_localization_presentation to identify the displayed Option-indexed quotient T with S_g as R-algebras. Reindex variables by (finSuccEquiv n).symm and equations by (finSuccEquiv c).symm to a Fin-indexed quotient U with n+1 variables and c+1 equations. The private construction reindex_quotient uses MvPolynomial.renameEquiv, Ideal.quotientEquivAlg and Ideal.map_span; equality of the relation ranges follows by the equation-index equivalence.

For each prime p of R with nonzero fibre of T, tensor the presentation isomorphism to transport the upper bound to p.Fiber T. Tensor the reindexing isomorphism to identify p.Fiber U with p.Fiber T. Construct the coefficient-base-change presentation using (Presentation.naive (v := fr)).baseChange p.ResidueField, its span_range_relation_eq_ker and quotientEquiv. Thus p.Fiber T is isomorphic to a quotient over p.ResidueField by c+1 equations in n+1 variables; all these rings are nonzero by the explicit equivalences. Apply AlgebraicGeometry.sub_le_topologicalKrullDim_spec_mvPolynomial_quotient with c+1 <= n+1. Homeomorphisms of spectra transport this lower bound. Since (n+1)-(c+1)=n-c, antisymmetry gives fibre dimension exactly n-c.

Witness Algebra.IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection by n+1, c+1, the reindexed relations fr, and the explicit inverse reindexing isomorphism U -> T. For each nonzero fibre of U, tensor this isomorphism, transport nontriviality and dimension, and apply the equality just proved for the fibre of T. The original requested fibre assertion follows from the same equality and the natural-number identities c+1 <= n+1 and (n+1)-(c+1)=n-c.
